stop_reason: The only deposited matrix is FPKM for 1178 genes that were PRE-SELECTED by fold change MMS D14 vs control (FPKM>1, FC<0.67 or >1.5; S4.8.p2). Any differential test on it is circular (features chosen on the outcome), is not genome-wide (BH/FDR over a selected subset is invalid), and cannot reproduce the paper's PoissonDis DEG call (needs full read counts). FPKM also cannot feed a count model. In addition the design has no exercise arm: it is a disuse model whose only loading-restoration arms (R1/R2) have no paper-reported DEG result. A genome-wide matrix would require re-processing the SRA reads, which is outside this run.
